sources.title: ccswarm crate manifest

sources.title: Release scope and roadmap
sources.locator: v0.10.2 scope; Known Runtime Limitations; Future Sangha Milestones
sources.finding: Lists known limits (approvals can accept despite revision vote, Sangha bypasses command gates, Codex writable workspace in read-only reviews, no workflow checkpoint resume) and undated Sangha milestones S1-S2 as design goals.

sources.title: Architecture
sources.finding: Workflow engine with sequential, parallel, team-leader and Sangha stages; providers, session bridge, events and governance modules.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.finding: v0.10.2 released 2026-10-09; Unreleased section empty at the tag.

sources.title: CLI definition
sources.finding: clap command tree (init, task, pipeline, queue, auto, run, replay, cost, flow, harness, approve, worktree, doctor, lab and more); output is text or --json.

sources.title: Flow engine types
sources.locator: Stage; parallel; team_leader; on_rate_limit; promotion; timeout
sources.finding: Stages support sequential, parallel sub-stages, team-leader workers, Sangha, per-stage timeout, provider promotion and rate-limit fallback.

sources.title: Sangha stage
sources.finding: Runs member assessments and counts APPROVE markers from completed reviews against quorum.

sources.title: Provider layer
sources.finding: Claude and Codex provider kinds (copilot fails fast); options include budget and worktree name.

sources.title: Claude provider
sources.finding: Runs `claude -p ... --dangerously-skip-permissions` with optional --worktree, stream-json and budget flags.

sources.title: Codex provider
sources.finding: Runs `codex exec` with workspace-write sandbox regardless of requested readonly permission.

sources.title: Queue state
sources.finding: Persistent YAML queue with claim states and a file lock so one runner claims each task.

sources.title: Auto mode
sources.finding: Drains the queue unattended, optionally polling for new queue items; supports wall-clock budget, stop-on-error, max iterations, auto-commit and PR creation.

sources.title: Workflow handler
sources.finding: After a run, optionally commits and opens a PR with `gh pr create` including flow, movement count and run id.

sources.title: Tracker adapters
sources.finding: Tracker trait with GitHub adapter that reads issues via `gh issue view`; the Linear adapter returns a not-yet-implemented error.

sources.title: Linear adapter
sources.finding: Returns "LinearAdapter not yet implemented" for fetch and list.

sources.title: Event recorder
sources.finding: Records every run as NDJSON events plus a summary under .ccswarm/runs.

sources.title: Human approval gate
sources.finding: Persistent approval records for risky actions, used by approve and auto --require-approval.

sources.title: Built-in hooks
sources.finding: Logging and security hooks, including a destructive-git guard.

sources.title: Resource monitor
sources.finding: CPU and memory tracking with limits and idle suspension, attached to sessions.

sources.title: Isolation modes
sources.finding: Default isolation is GitWorktree; Container and Hybrid depend on the optional container feature.

sources.title: Session bridge
sources.finding: Provider session handling with retry, persistence and optional A2A remote routing via CCSWARM_A2A_ENDPOINT.

sources.title: Agent module
sources.finding: References crate::container::docker, which is absent from the pinned source tree.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 157 stars, MIT, default branch master, pushed 2026-11-07, not archived, 16 open issues; latest release v0.10.2 (2026-10-09), 12 releases.

sources.title: GitHub releases

sources.locator: rg -i "ratatui|crossterm|axum|actix|warp::|hyper::server|tauri|electron" over crates/ccswarm/src and Cargo.toml; ls src
sources.finding: No TUI, web server or desktop code; ratatui is not a dependency; only the CLI binary exists (A2A is an outbound client).

sources.title: Bounded search: MCP
sources.finding: No MCP client or server.

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules and webhooks
sources.finding: No scheduler or webhook; auto --watch only polls the local queue file.

sources.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO
sources.finding: No accounts, roles or SSO; Sangha members and personas are agent roles.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost and billing
sources.finding: cost command reports per-stage and per-agent figures from recorded events; max_budget passes --max-budget-usd to Claude; no billing.

sources.title: Bounded search: container module
sources.finding: No container module exists in the pinned tree although the optional feature and agent code reference one.

sources.title: Bounded search: deploy and verification gates
sources.finding: Stage gates run commands per stage; no deploy or rollback; undo is advisory.
